Container.Name: maloja-mcp
Container.Overview: Read-only MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Maloja, the self-hosted scrobble database. Lets Claude and other MCP clients answer questions about your listening history: recent plays, top artists/tracks/albums for any period, listening trends, yearly number ones and per-artist/track/album stats. Streamable HTTP on the /mcp endpoint. Set MCP_AUTH_TOKEN and send it as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" from your MCP client or gateway.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Streamable HTTP MCP port. MCP URL: http://[IP]:[PORT]/mcp

Config.Name: MALOJA_URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Maloja server, reachable from inside this container.

Config.Name: MALOJA_TIMEZONE
Config.Description: IANA time zone used for 'today', 'last_month' etc. and for displayed play times. Should match Maloja's own MALOJA_LOCATION_TIMEZONE.

Config.Name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bearer token required on /mcp. Strongly recommended. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: MALOJA_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Maloja API key. Not needed for the read-only endpoints this server uses on a default Maloja install.
